node.statement: Lemma 4.1 (Moment bounds for GKKT): Let t = 6d+1, P the approximate t-design from Theorem 4.1. Sample V from P, measure in the standard basis to get outcome |j>, and define rho_hat = (d+1)V^dag|j><j|V - I. Then for all unit vectors |z> and integers 2 <= k <= t/3: E[|<z|(rho_hat - |v><v|)|z>|^k] <= 41 * 6^{k-2} * k!. Proof: Expand the k-th moment using the approximate t-design property. The t-design condition with t >= 3k ensures the first 3k moments match the Haar case up to a (1 +/- 1/2) factor. The Haar moments are computed using the symmetric subspace projector formula, giving the bound.
